title: After Resisting the Greed
description:
Two months since you held back the greed and walked out of the cafe situation.
Today someone who was there called.
"Good thing you didn't do it."

choices.result_text:
You heard what happened after.
Holding back had been right.

choices.text: "I did think about how nice it would've been if it worked."
choices.result_text:
'I thought about it too,' you said.
They said 'Even if it worked, you'd have gone all in next round.'

title: After the Guilt Lifted
description:
Two months since you resolved the guilt that came from the cafe situation.
Today you saw that person again.

choices.result_text:
It was natural.
The relief showed — in this conversation.
Carrying guilt makes conversation awkward.

choices.text: Bring up that incident one more time
choices.result_text:
"I still think about what happened then," you said.
They said 'Me too.'

title: The Cafe Mentor's Network
description:
Three months since the mentor you met at the cafe exchanged contacts with you.
Today one of those contacts reached out first.

choices.result_text:
You met.
What started at a cafe — had traveled here.

choices.text: Look into who they are first
choices.result_text:
You looked into them first.
Trustworthy route.
You met.

title: After Holding Back on Crypto
description:
Two months since you held back the greed and sold the coin.
Today you checked the current price.

choices.text: It was the right time to sell
choices.result_text:
It had gone up further — then dropped by half.
Selling when you did was right.
The timing of holding back greed — proved itself in results.

choices.text: The higher it went, the more I feel I missed
choices.result_text:
You thought about the higher prices.
But the lower ones were visible too.
Selling at the top was luck.

title: Talking a Friend Out of Crypto
description:
Three months since you talked a friend out of putting big money into crypto.
Today that friend called.
"Hey — I'm glad I listened to you."

choices.result_text:
'Really glad,' you said.
The friend replied 'Thanks for back then.'
Trying to stop someone risks making things awkward.

'You got lucky,' you said.
They replied 'No — you read it right.'

title: The Confirmed Crypto Loss
description:
Two months since the crypto loss was confirmed.
Today you looked at that number again.

choices.text: Write it off as tuition and move on
choices.result_text:
You moved on.
You wrote down how much you'd lost.
For this to be tuition — you couldn't go in the same way again.

You looked for recovery.
Looking for it in the same place — became the same approach.

title: After Confessing the Interview Lie
description:
Two months since you came clean — post-joining — about the exaggeration in your interview.
Today the team lead called you in separately.

choices.result_text:
The team lead said 'I appreciated you telling me honestly.'
Not a reprimand.
The confession had built trust.

title: The Result of Doubling Down
description:
Two months since you covered the interview exaggeration with a bigger lie.
Today it came out.

choices.result_text:
You told the truth.
The team lead's expression was hard.
'Why didn't you say so sooner,' they said.
The bigger the lie stacks — the harder it is to tell the truth.

You denied it.
They produced the evidence.
Lies always get found out.

title: After Questioning Jaehyuk
description:
A month since you questioned Jaehyuk's behavior directly.
Today Jaehyuk came to find you first.

choices.text: Hear what he has to say
choices.result_text: Jaehyuk said 'I'm glad you asked directly.'

choices.text: Ask first: "Something you want to say?"
choices.result_text:
You said 'Is there something you want to tell me?'
He said 'Yeah — it's about back then.'

title: The Final Break with Jaehyuk
description:
Two months since you completely cut ties with Jaehyuk.
Today you heard about him from a mutual contact.

choices.result_text:
You listened.
Jaehyuk was the same.
Cutting things off had been confirmed as right.

'Let's not,' you said.
They said 'Okay.'
Cutting it was cutting it.

title: When Analysis Is a Habit
description:
Three months since you made pre-investment analysis a habit.
Today for the first time — you almost bought without analyzing. And stopped.

choices.result_text:
You stopped and analyzed.
The outcome was good.
Holding up against impulse — that was what the habit was really for.

You went with gut.
The outcome was uncertain.

title: After the Leverage Lesson
description:
Three months since losing big on leverage and learning the lesson.
Today a leverage product ad appeared again.
"This time it's an opportunity."

choices.result_text:
You closed it.
Ads always said 'This time it's an opportunity.'
Sometimes they were right.

choices.text: At least look at the content
choices.result_text:
You looked.
It sounded plausible.
Plausible was what made it dangerous.

title: After Learning About Greed
description:
Three months since you learned firsthand that greed creates losses.
Today a similar situation arrived.

choices.result_text:
You stopped.
You pulled out when you had enough.
A lesson is for using when the same moment returns.

You said 'This time is different.'
Everyone who'd ever said that — had seen the same ending.

title: After the Partial Exit
description:
Two months since you sold part of your startup stake.
You still hold some.
Today the founder sent an update.

choices.result_text:
You reviewed it.
The exited portion was locked in — the rest needed watching.

choices.text: Good news — better to hold more
choices.result_text:
You decided to hold more.
The founder's optimism had colored your judgment.
